headword: {音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}
gloss: sound equipment; audio system; PA system

definitions.gloss: sound equipment; audio system; PA system
definitions.explanation: The collection of equipment — speakers, amplifiers, microphones, mixers, and related devices — installed in a venue to handle sound production and amplification. Used for concerts, theaters, conference rooms, wedding halls, schools, and public facilities.

examples.japanese: {音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: To set up the sound equipment.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This hall has well-equipped sound facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動作|どうさ}→動作：04074_dousa⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Before the event, we checked the operation of the sound equipment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備|そな}えている→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧。
examples.english: The newly built concert hall is equipped with the latest sound equipment.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧ (sound, acoustics) + ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧ (facilities, equipment). Refers to installed or semi-permanent equipment, as opposed to individual devices.

USAGE:
- Typically used when describing a venue's facilities: concert halls, theaters, churches, conference rooms, school auditoriums.
- In event planning and rental listings, {音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび} is commonly listed alongside lighting (⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧) and stage (⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧) equipment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to set up / prepare the sound equipment
- {音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: the sound equipment is well-stocked/high quality
- {音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to be equipped with sound equipment
- {音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: inspection of sound equipment
- ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音響|おんきょう}{設備|せつび}: state-of-the-art sound equipment

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{音響|おんきょう}→音響：16316_onkyou⟧: acoustics, sound — the broader concept of sound
- オーディオ: audio — often for home or personal systems, rather than installed equipment
- PA (ピーエー): public address system — a subset of sound equipment focused on voice amplification
- ⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧: lighting equipment — commonly paired with sound equipment in venue listings
- ⟦{音響|おんきょう}{効果|こうか}→音響効果：24273_onkyoukouka⟧: sound effects / acoustics — the effect produced rather than the equipment itself
